cards.headline: Lamine, Pedri and Fermín join voluntary work on the rest day before the Clásico
cards.summary: Hansi Flick gave the squad Thursday off after the PSG defeat, but Lamine Yamal, Pedri, Fermín López, Xavi Espart, Gerard Martín and Wojciech Szczęsny reported to the Ciutat Esportiva. Injured players including Jules Koundé, Dani Olmo, Eric García, Andreas Christensen and Roony Bardghji also attended recovery sessions. The group returns to full training on Friday at 11:00 ahead of Sunday’s Clásico.
cards.body: Mundo Deportivo and MARCA both reported the voluntary attendance on the first rest day in two weeks. Flick had scheduled the break so the side could recover from the high-intensity 4-2 loss in Paris and the busy run of matches. The players who logged the most minutes against PSG had already done gym work on Wednesday while the rest trained on the pitch. Thursday’s session was not mandatory. Official club channels had posted recovery images the previous day. The Clásico is at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday at 21:00. Barça sit six points clear of Real Madrid after nine league wins. The voluntary work comes with several first-team defenders still limited. Koundé remains doubtful with an ankle sprain, Eric García is out for three to four weeks, and Olmo is sidelined for around a month with a left adductor injury. Training resumes at 11:00 on Friday.

cards.headline: Xavi Espart says the Clásico will be a war and Barça will go all out
cards.summary: Xavi Espart told reporters after the PSG match that Sunday’s Clásico will be a war. The 19-year-old full-back said the side will go all out, give 100 per cent and take the chance to extend the lead over Real Madrid. He scored his first Champions League goal in the 55th minute against PSG and is expected to start at right-back.
cards.body: Espart made the comments in the mixed zone at the Parc des Princes. Mundo Deportivo led with the quotes on Thursday. The defender, born in 2007, started against the European champions alongside Cubarsí, Yamal and Bernal. Flick praised his display after the 4-2 defeat. Espart equalised after a combination with Fermín and finished at 31.2 km/h according to UEFA data. He becomes the youngest Spanish defender to score in the Champions League. The Clásico is his first against Real Madrid as a regular. Vinícius is banned for the league game. Barça can open a nine-point gap with a win at Spotify Camp Nou. Koundé remains a doubt with an ankle sprain, so Espart is the clear first option on the right. The squad returns to training on Friday morning.

cards.headline: Jürgen Klopp says he supports the better team and that is Barcelona
cards.summary: Jürgen Klopp told DAZN he will watch the Clásico and currently supports the better side, which he believes is Barcelona. The Germany coach said he used to lean toward Barça because he disliked the aggressive defending of Pepe and others at Real Madrid. He now watches more neutrally but still rates Flick’s side ahead.
cards.body: Klopp made the comments during coverage of Bayern’s Champions League match. SPORT, COPE and Barça Blaugranes all carried the quotes on Thursday. He confirmed he has watched every Clásico of his life. Barça lead La Liga by six points after nine wins from nine before Tuesday’s European result. Real Madrid sit behind them. The match is at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday at 21:00. Vinícius is banned. Klopp’s remark comes after Barça’s first defeat of the season, a 4-2 loss at PSG. Flick had already said titles are not won in October. The German coach’s comments were widely shared by Spanish outlets on the eve of the fixture. Adeyemi is the only German international expected in the Barça squad for Sunday.

cards.headline: Camp Nou mosaic will read “Batec blaugrana” for the Clásico
cards.summary: SPORT reported that Spotify Camp Nou will display a full-stand mosaic for Sunday’s Clásico. The main message on the lateral will read “Batec blaugrana”. The design also includes the senyera. Cards will be distributed so fans can form the image before kick-off at 21:00.
cards.body: Ivan San Antonio wrote the story for SPORT on Thursday. The club chose the heartbeat message over a giant crest after reviewing several options. The mosaic covers the stands and is designed to create atmosphere from the moment the teams come out. Camp Nou has used similar displays for previous Clásicos. The match is the first of the season between the sides. Barça can extend their six-point lead at the top of La Liga. Real Madrid travel without Vinícius, who is suspended. Institutional tension remains between the clubs. Florentino Pérez is not expected to travel, and there will be no traditional board lunch. The mosaic is one of the visible signs the stadium is prepared for the fixture despite ongoing renovation work.

cards.headline: Cancelo answers criticism after PSG and says he wants critics to handle the pressure
cards.summary: João Cancelo responded on social media to criticism of his display against PSG. The full-back wrote that he would like to see the critics enter the pitch and withstand the pressure. SPORT reported the post on Thursday ahead of the Clásico.
cards.body: Cancelo started at left-back against the European champions in a defence already missing Koundé and Eric García. Barça lost 4-2. The Portuguese defender has been used on both sides this season under Flick. His post appeared after several accounts questioned his positioning and recovery runs in Paris. The Clásico is three days away. Cancelo is expected to start again on Sunday with the backline still thin. Espart is the leading option on the right. Gerard Martín played in Paris despite arriving with a knock. The squad trained on Wednesday and had Thursday free. Full training resumes on Friday at 11:00 at the Ciutat Esportiva. Cancelo’s availability is not in question.

cards.headline: Florentino Pérez will not travel to Barcelona for the Clásico
cards.summary: SPORT reported that Real Madrid president Florentino Pérez will not travel to Barcelona for Sunday’s Clásico. There will also be no traditional lunch between the two boards. The paper described ongoing institutional tension between the clubs.
cards.body: Chris Blasco filed the story for SPORT on Thursday. The absence of the Madrid president and the cancellation of the directors’ meal come after months of friction over refereeing, scheduling and public statements. The match itself remains confirmed for 21:00 at Spotify Camp Nou. Barça have said the fixture will go ahead normally despite a strike by discontinuous staff. The club has arranged cover. On the pitch, Vinícius is banned and Barça can open a nine-point gap. Flick’s side are without Olmo for around a month and still assessing Koundé. The institutional backdrop has been noted by both Spanish papers and Madrid-based outlets. The Clásico is the first of the 2026/27 season.

cards.headline: Barça guarantees the Clásico will go ahead despite discontinuous staff strike
cards.summary: Mundo Deportivo reported that FC Barcelona has confirmed the Clásico will take place as scheduled on Sunday despite a strike by discontinuous staff. The club said it has arranged the necessary cover so the match at Spotify Camp Nou proceeds normally at 21:00.
cards.body: The report appeared on Thursday afternoon. Discontinuous staff are temporary workers used for matchdays. The club stated the fixture is guaranteed. Camp Nou will also feature the “Batec blaugrana” mosaic. Real Madrid travel without Vinícius. Barça lead the table by six points and can extend that margin. Training resumes on Friday morning after Thursday’s rest day. Several players including Lamine Yamal, Pedri and Fermín had already done voluntary work at the Ciutat Esportiva. The institutional tension between the clubs continues, with Florentino Pérez not expected to attend. The match remains the main focus for both sides after Barça’s 4-2 defeat at PSG on Tuesday.

cards.headline: Injury list for the Clásico: Olmo out a month, Koundé a doubt, Eric unavailable
cards.summary: Dani Olmo is ruled out for around a month with a left adductor injury sustained against PSG. Eric García remains out for three to four weeks. Jules Koundé is a doubt with a grade-one ankle sprain and is not expected to start. Xavi Espart is the leading right-back option.
cards.body: The club confirmed Olmo’s injury on Wednesday. Tests showed a left adductor problem after a collision with Vitinha. He will miss the Clásico and the international break. Eric García’s thigh issue was confirmed earlier in the week. Koundé’s ankle sprain kept him out of the PSG match; Mundo Deportivo and AS both reported the coaching staff are pessimistic about his chances for Sunday. Espart started and scored against PSG and is available. Cancelo and Gerard Martín are the other senior full-back options. Christensen is still working back. The squad returns to full training on Friday at 11:00. Flick has already managed minutes with the Madrid game in mind. Rodri started on the bench in Paris so he would be fresh for the Clásico.

cards.headline: Official channels post Clásico memories and Espart’s approach ahead of Sunday
cards.summary: FC Barcelona posted highlights from the last two home Clásicos and a video on how Xavi Espart is preparing for his first Barça-Madrid. The posts appeared on Thursday as the squad prepared to return to training on Friday at 11:00.
cards.body: The club’s English account shared clips under the La Liga highlights tag and a separate piece on Espart’s mindset. The 19-year-old full-back scored on his full Champions League debut against PSG and is expected to start on the right. The Clásico is at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday at 21:00. Barça can open a nine-point gap. Vinícius is banned. The posts sit alongside the mosaic announcement and the voluntary training reports. Flick’s side lost 4-2 at PSG on Tuesday, their first defeat of the season. Recovery continued on Wednesday and Thursday was free. Full training resumes at 11:00 on Friday at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper. The next competitive match is the league fixture against Real Madrid.
